about.description: Established in 1975 by Gerald King and David Bodenhamer in an old bait shop on a pier in Gulf Shores, Alabama, Sea-N-Suds is one of the original family-friendly beachfront restaurants in town. The restaurant stretches over the sugar-white sand and sits just a couple of feet away from the Gulf of Mexico, offering true beachfront dining. The original building was destroyed by Hurricane Frederic in 1979 and rebuilt. The restaurant still serves the same seafood using the same recipes passed down for generations, including their famous gumbo recipe from David Bodenhamer's grandmother, Nona Sellers, which has been in the family for over 200 years.
about.elevator_pitch: A beloved Gulf Shores institution since 1975, Sea-N-Suds serves fresh Gulf seafood and legendary family-recipe gumbo right on the beach with stunning sunset views.
about.vibe: Casual beachfront family dining with stunning Gulf views
about.parking: Self-park in the Northside parking lot; valet parking currently unavailable
about.insider_tip: Tuesday nights are THE night for seafood locals — come for the All You Can Eat fresh fried mullet special on Tuesdays and Fridays. Pick up a Locals Loyalty Card for $15 to get 10% off every visit.
